mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in real GDP growth above 3% signals accelerating demand, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth above 3% fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between GDP growth and SPX returns becomes statistically insignificant (p > 0.05) over a 5-year rolling window.
